constraints.text: Hacker News is configured as an rss source with url https://news.ycombinator.com/rss (cerebro, 2026-10-10); a title-only HN item's stored content is the feed's Comments anchor.
Measured 2026-10-10: Firebase item 50034081 lists kids in HN's ranked order; Algolia's items endpoint lists the same story's children in ascending id order.

The link-without-article rule is decided in docs/work/title-only-misfires/design.json ('A Reddit link post with no article and no self-text is title-only by code ... whatever its comments'); the operator reversed that on 2026-10-10 for discussion that has prose.
The substantive verdict feeds title_only_reason's model:not_substantive; left unchanged, it would mark every discussion-basis item title-only.
Principle II: a summary of a discussion must be distinguishable from a summary of the article, in storage and where the reader sees it.
Third-party HTTP in tests is replayed from vcrpy cassettes with no network (recorded-youtube-tests).

related.query: gh issue list --state open --search "reddit OR comments OR refetch"
